about_the_game:
Halloween 2048 is a Halloween themed tile merge game based on the classic puzzle with the goal of reaching the top tile at each level, progress through all 28 levels and reach All Saints Day. You move tiles around the board using either your mouse, keyboard or controller and when two, three or more tiles of the same type touch, they merge into one and give you points. You earn bonus actions for merging more than two tiles in a row and completing levels. Bonus actions are tapping a tile to remove it, tapping a tile to remove all of that tile type, switching tile positions or even increasing the board size. The game includes two difficulty levels; normal and hard. Earn achievements for completing top levels, and climb the two different difficulty leaderboards.

This game Includes a great Halloween soundtrack or over 120 Halloween themed songs that play in a random rotation. Great for listening to on Halloween night and getting your scare on!

short_description: Halloween 2048 is a Halloween themed tile merge game better than the original. Complete all 28 levels, reach All Saints day and win the game! All levels have Halloween images that must be matched and merged. Earn bonus actions to remove a tile or tiles, swap tile positions, or increase board size.
